messages:
maria: Hey team, I signed up yesterday and completed email verification but my free-trial credits never showed up. account email: maria@acme.com. Region: DE. I added a card but still 0 credits. Anyone seen this? :confused:

alex_support: Hey Maria — sorry about that. Do you have the account id? can you paste it here or DM? Also did you try refreshing the Console? sometimes the balance takes a second to update. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Account ID: `acct_01Gz4X9YzR8bZ3` (from the welcome email). refreshed console multiple times, tried incognito, still shows 0. No promo code used, expected default 100 credits from signup.

alex_support: Thanks. Quick checklist: 1) email verified (you said yes) 2) payment method attached (you said yes) 3) region gating — sometimes EU accounts require additional validation for certain promos. pinging @samir_billing to check if promo grants were blocked.

samir_billing: @alex_support thanks for the ping. I pulled the account. It looks like the account flagged under the EU payment gating rule because the card BIN is from outside the EU and ACME's org address is set to DE. Our promo engine currently enforces either EU billing address or a list of accepted EU card BINs for region-specific credits. I'm going to run a manual grant while we decide if we should loosen that rule.

maria: Oh interesting — my card is US-issuing but company HQ in DE. That could be it. Is there anything I need to do?

samir_billing: If you prefer automated resolution, you can add a secondary EU card or update the org billing address to match the card country. For now I'll manually apply the trial credits. Doing that now.

account-bot: [system] Granting promo: `free_trial_100` -> acct_01Gz4X9YzR8bZ3. Request ID: `req_20250312_9982`. Status: queued.

alex_support: I added a small repro note to the ticket: "EU region + non-EU card blocked default trial grant" so we can track. Maria, once the bot finishes, can you confirm balance?

account-bot: [system] Promo applied successfully. acct_01Gz4X9YzR8bZ3 now has 100 free credits.

maria: I see them now, thanks! :tada: Appreciate the quick manual fix. Could you open a follow-up to consider allowing mixed-region orgs to get trial credits? Our legal team wants to prototype in EU region but finance uses US cards.

samir_billing: Absolutely — filing follow-up. Filed as BILL-4523. Summary: allow trial grants for org-country != card-country when org verifies business domain + email verification. Adding risk acceptance checklist for fraud team.

alex_support: Nice. Adding a short KB snippet we can point other customers to: "If trial credits don't appear after signup, check email verification, payment method, and region gating. Contact support with account ID to request manual grant." Will link BILL-4523.

maria: Sweet. One more small ask — can you confirm whether promo codes (we might get one from our vendor) would also get blocked by the same rule?

samir_billing: Good question. Promo code engine currently reuses the same gating logic for trial grants. I'll add an item to the ticket to decouple them if needed.

alex_support: Thanks everyone. Closing loop for Maria. If anything else pops up, DM me. :thumbsup:
